verdict.rationale: Reader's own SaaS proxy mode (`x-proxy: auto`) rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically, which comes close to the story. However, nothing documents retry-on-block behavior or an ordered fallback chain across different proxies, and it requires an API key. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry when a request is blocked, a configurable chain or ordered fallback of distinct proxies (including user-supplied ones), and independent or hands-on corroboration of block-recovery behavior.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request

citations.quote: Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.
